modelingScope.memoryUsage: metrics.memoryUsage is synthetic aggregate utilization. It cannot be converted into per-pod GiB, working-set demand, OOM timing, cgroup limits, eviction, or OOMKill behavior. Native Kubernetes manifest requests/limits are observed configuration only; an explicit runtimeMemoryProfile (compute) or kubernetesMemoryProfile (kubernetes) is required to model per-replica memory-pressure/OOM assumptions. Runtime results are reported each step in metrics.kubernetesMemory with an explicit evaluationStatus, never inferred from memoryUsage, CPU, RPS, requests, or limits. Multi-pool clusters (nodePools) are evaluated per node pool: each pool declares its own kubernetesMemoryProfile and gets its own row (poolId-tagged, sharing the cluster's resourceId); a pool without one reports evaluationStatus "not_evaluated" independently of its siblings.
modelingScope.controlPlane: CWM includes a control-plane management fee where applicable as a cost-only term. It does not simulate or report GKE control-plane CPU, master/API throttling, or control-plane cooldown behavior.
modelingScope.kubernetesCpuHpa: The optional kubernetesCpuHpa model derives a per-pod CPU observation from routed RPS and an explicit millicores-per-RPS demand value, then reports bounded Utilization/AverageValue replica recommendations. A reviewed CPU/RPS measurement series may be included as calibration evidence and must produce the declared demand value. It updates workload replicas only, not worker nodes or live clusters, and does not claim Kubernetes HPA controller parity. CPU request and demand are labeled ASSUMED unless supporting evidence is supplied; no values are inferred when omitted.
modelingScope.kubernetesWorkerCapacity: CWM models generic worker-node capacity, CPU/utilization, load saturation, worker autoscaling, and worker recovery/cooldown decisions only; it does not model pod scheduling, readiness, queues, or control-plane CPU.
